newsitem.title: UK: Rotterdam bunker fuel continues quiet.
newsitem.headline: Rotterdam bunker fuel continues quiet.

text.p: Rotterdam and Antwerp bunker prices were little changed in very quiet trade on Friday, with volume totalling only about 10,000 tonnes, dealers said. "Demand is okay and avails are good but it was a quiet day," one dealer said.

Rotterdam 380 cst was priced at about $85 a tonne, with 180 cst at $90. Antwerp prices were about the same to $1 above Rotterdam. The Mediterranean was also little changed from Thursday, with Piraeus 380 cst at $91/92 and 180 cst some $7 higher. Fos 380 cst was priced at $89 and 180 cst at $98.
Fujairah 380 cst was likewise steady with 380 cst at $96/100 and 180 cst at $103/105.
